title: Whispering Whelk Waltzer
statement: A pearly spiral-shelled snail the color of old moonlight, it glides in slow figure-eights through a tank of teal dusk, trailing a ribbon of glowing plankton and humming tiny bubbles as it goes. It keeps a small collection of sea-glass lanterns tucked among the kelp and a drowsy, slightly lopsided dance that pauses whenever a visitor stops to watch.
